model: Two-coefficient linear sensor dynamics induced by anatomical gain and graph Laplacian; not fitted Epileptor or a therapeutic intervention planner
split: First 60% training; next 20% validation; final 20% development test. Omit first 50 samples of each later block as embargo.
selection: Choose anatomical inverse ridge from [1e-6,1e-4,1e-2,1] by validation MSE at 10-sample forecast horizon; deterministic first tie
claims: Exploratory within-recording forecast errors and sensitivity to connectivity. No independent patient evaluation, parameter recovery, intervention benefit or clinical benefit.
runtime: One GCP CPU thread, within shared development-v2 3600-second wall cap; max 120 seconds for this baseline
